original_prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE original adult character portrait for a cohesive premium 3D romance-game character collection. Polished 2.5D/3D sculpted digital character, unmistakably high-end CG, refined attractive facial modeling, anatomically elegant proportions, expressive eyes only subtly enlarged, detailed groomed individual hair strands, soft realistic subsurface scattering with restrained skin microtexture and low sheen, dimensional fabric and metals. Not a live-action photograph, not flat anime, not a doll or plastic toy. All characters aged 22-28. Clean opaque pure white #FFFFFF seamless background with no gray gradient, scenery or props behind them. Consistent neutral soft frontal studio key plus subtle modeling fill, clean whites, no warm color cast. Portrait 3:4 composition, chest-up, camera at eye level, entire hairstyle and any head accessory inside frame with white margin, face mostly frontal, shoulders visible, no hands in frame. Single person only. No text, no numbers, no logos, no watermark, no signature, no border. References are inspiration ONLY: design a distinct new identity, significantly redesign facial proportions, eye shape, nose, jaw, hairstyle details, jewelry and costume while retaining the broad temperament and palette. Do not merely retouch or reproduce the source character. Character 04: Feminine adventurous freckled woodland scout. Textured chin-length warm chestnut bob with asymmetric long fringe, hazel green eyes, distinct angular cheekbones, wider nose tip, light natural freckles. Muted sage canvas jacket and ivory shirt, narrow dark leather necklace with one sculpted silver fern pendant, not animal-head choker. Confident attentive expression. Input image 1 is the source mood reference ONLY: invent a clearly different person as described. Input image 2 is the RENDERING STYLE ANCHOR ONLY: match its 3D surface quality, refined facial sculpting, soft neutral white lighting and portrait crop. DO NOT copy the style anchor's identity, hair, clothes, jewelry or fantasy genre. Follow this character's specified genre and wardrobe. Retain a distinct original identity, no recycled same-face cast.
